points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake, documented dependencies, case JSON, and run tooling are committed; no fresh clean build was performed.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Input-driven solver and documented commands are present; no new executable run was needed after validator evidence.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Committed C++ separates mesh, partition, flux, reconstruction, solver, output, and configuration modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal executable wrapper was found. Trust policy excludes external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Generic CGNS reader and JSON boundary/case configuration drive the production paths.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS partitioning, ghost exchange and global reductions are implemented; delivered finals use mixed rank counts, limiting a clean rank comparison.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Finite/admissibility, geometry and input checks are visible; no independent memory stress test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Readable eight-case packages passed the explicit validator; no clean unit-test suite was independently executed.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Structured, commented implementation and report sources; campaign artifacts are appropriately excluded from the immutable submission.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas equations, nondimensionalization and coefficients are documented and implemented.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured topology, boundary families, geometry and adjacency are handled in source.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Cell-centred conservative face residual assembly and global norms are source-supported.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov and selectable HLLC fluxes are documented; no independent shock accuracy study was run.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip/adiabatic paths and wall-output semantics are explicitly documented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares piecewise-linear production reconstruction and fallback are documented and source-supported.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkatakrishnan/Barth-Jespersen and positivity controls are described; final metadata records Barth-Jespersen, so report/config detail is qualified.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Corrected face gradients, Newtonian/Fourier terms and tangential force split are supported.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS implicit pseudo-time source is present; two low-Mach laminar packages are statistically periodic rather than steady converged.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 dual-time controls are in source and delivered Re200 metadata is completed/statistically_periodic; Re200 was not rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS k-way, owned/ghost scheduling and MPI paths are source-supported; no controlled rank-only comparison was verified.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Explicit validator accepted all eight specified original packages and report.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Recorded explicit examiner validation returned rc 0; Re200 was not rerun.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All packages are structurally complete and marked completed; two low-Mach laminar cases are statistically periodic, not steady converged.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Finite histories and report analysis support plausibility; mixed np2/np4/np8 final packages do not establish a controlled MPI comparison.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Committed report figure manifest resolves 60 figure entries with no missing figure files.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Detailed report states numerical controls, plateaus and limitations, and distinguishes statistically periodic cases.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Manifest resolves figures; raw data remain read-only workspace evidence and are intentionally outside the result commit.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Strong CMake/CLI documentation and validator-compliant outputs; no fresh clean rebuild.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: Generic CGNS unstructured geometry, boundary families and interfaces are implemented.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative FV residual with documented farfield, slip and no-slip treatment.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Least-squares reconstruction and controls are strong; limiter selection detail is qualified by final metadata.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Viscous gradients, heat flux and force decomposition are source/report supported.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Implicit LU-SGS and delivered BDF2 Re200 evidence are strong; Re200 was not rerun and two steady-design cases plateau.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, halo exchange and reductions are implemented; no clean rank-only comparison was established.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: All eight passed validator; two low-Mach laminar cases are statistically periodic rather than steady converged.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Detailed, readable report with resolved figure manifest and stated limitations.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Modular configurable solver, though campaign-specific scripts and limited independent clean-build evidence constrain reproducibility.
